additional_info.subject: Action by RC:
additional_info.body:
The station was measured in several states during measurements:
- open,
- closed,
- closed with off: FC18, FC20, FC21, FC22,
- closed with the emergency button pressed,
The measurement was made on the charger's power supply inside before 3VA. Rogowski coils were salivated on the power cables and voltage probes on the 3VA buses.
Open state::
- the station has a consumption of 300-400 watts,
Closed state:
- the station has a consumption of 7558 W,
Closed station with circuits turned off:
- consumption not much less 7500 W,
Station closed with emergency button pressed:
- consumption like an open station - 300-400W,
The stations were checked on the power supply of the power modules:
- each phase of the modules consume between 0.9 - 1.1 A. I attached is a video.

additional_info.subject: Customer audit
additional_info.body:
I don't know if this note will be helpful to you, but I am attaching it along with a power consumption analysis file.
I am additionally interested in whether the increased active power consumption also occurs during an ongoing charging session.
(As of February 21, we activated PowerSave mode to reduce excessive power consumption.)
I checked one charging session from 23.02. after midnight. The maximum consumption of the car is about 151.7 kW DC, according to the power consumption analyzer it was about 160kW.
The station in a normal system would not draw nearly 8 kW of power for its own needs and power transformation. I assume that upgrading the charger from 4.0 to 6.0.3 did not change the active power consumption.

additional_info.subject: 0408900 - ID0406824-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R2 170001500] Charger takes around 7kW in standby. (C1) CRM:00472000287
additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
Answering to your last note left on this ticket, I didn't observe any fault on your measurements or charger issue. Note that the charger efficiency is not 100%. So when you are measuring from the grid 160kW of power, it doesn't mean you are delivering 160kW to the car.
The internal consumption plus the converter efficiency will consume that difference in the power measured and delivered.
Since we already had a chat to clarify this topic and since there is no activity from service side in this case I will proceed to close this ticket.
Any additional questions that you still may have, feel free to approach me or any of my colleagues for clarification.
